admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope. Aland (AX) is a territory, not a sovereign state (an autonomous region of Finland). In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=AX is relation 1650407; it is boundary=administrative with admin_level 3, not 2, because the territory sits below a sovereign state, so the default admin-0 rule (boundary=administrative, admin_level=2) finds none. Territory, game venue map only, no claims: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
